stem.text: Water waves in a ripple tank are made to pass through a small gap, as shown.
Which diagram shows the waves after they have passed through the gap?

A.alt: Ripple tank diagram: straight plane waves travel from the left towards a barrier with a gap. Beyond the gap, circular arcs spread out to the right, drawn with arrows showing the direction of travel.

B.alt: Ripple tank diagram: straight plane waves travel from the left towards a barrier with a gap. Beyond the gap, a few short arcs are drawn with arrows showing the direction of travel.

C.alt: Ripple tank diagram: straight plane waves travel from the left towards a barrier with a gap. Beyond the gap, wavy arcs spread out to the right, drawn with arrows showing the direction of travel.

D.alt: Ripple tank diagram: straight plane waves travel from the left towards a barrier with a gap. Beyond the gap, a few narrow arcs curve around the gap and spread out to the right, drawn with arrows showing the direction of travel.
